source: docs/p110-f-native-ab.md (Gates, pre-registered). ab_report.py evaluates this file and run_ab.py reads the arm structure from it; the doc is the normative text. gates.json is the frozen file of the 2026-09-27 A/B.

structure._note: Manipulation checks per cell (validity). Control is main 70e6e55, which carries A + C: short tape header, long tool line. F changes only the tool line; its request prefix (system prompt, tool definitions) must equal control's byte for byte.

unit.pairing: same task and rep index; the two cells of a pair ran back to back, one cell at a time, the first arm rotating with (rep - 1 + seed)

min_pairs._note: Of 21 pairs (scope all) and 15 (recall_g2) per batch. A check evaluated on fewer valid pairs is 'insufficient', which blocks shipping. Pooled over the arbitration batch the minimums scale with the number of rep sets (x2: 34 of 42, 20 of 30).

pooled._note: ab_report.py --pooled: count margins and minimum pair counts double; ratio, median and rate limits do not change; the room requirement does not change.

room._note: F ships only if every check passes with at least one unit of room (docs/p110-f-native-ab.md §9): limit minus value >= 1 count for count checks, >= 0.05 for a cost ratio, >= 1 request for the median request delta, >= 1 cross-turn target for the first-try rate, and for the per-task drop no task below control. Equality checks (every F rejection recovered) have no room: they pass or fail.

cell_counts_only_if: every turn exited 0 or ended with a model-attributable turn_end (the step cap 'blocked', 'max-tokens', or 'error' with a code outside the infra list); never an infra error (TRANSPORT, RATE_LIMIT, SERVER, TIMEOUT, EMPTY_RESPONSE, MISSING_CREDENTIAL, INVALID_CREDENTIAL, AUTH, QUOTA, ACCOUNT_QUOTA, NO_ADAPTER, ABORTED, HTTP 5xx), a missing turn_end, a harness timeout or a budget kill
system prompt and slice tool fingerprints equal the arm's entry in fingerprints.json
16 tools (the fingerprinted count), one tool list and one system prompt for the whole session
one turn per prompt: user prompts = turn ends = prompts, no goal-round messages
the system prompt contains no /private or /Users
tape header and tool-line forms are the arm's (control short/long, F short/v); every tape header 76 or 78 chars
structural, F: system prompt sha, slice tool sha and request prefix chars equal control's
isolation: no blocked path (vault, worktrees) changed mode, inode or ctime while a turn ran
r3 only: a fold replacement of a turn-1 read exists
r1, r2, r4 (meta delivery): every delivery turn shows the exam's fact in a non-recall tool result (the script's output was not discarded)
validity.pair_rule: a (task, rep) pair counts only when both the F cell and the control cell are valid; dropped pairs are listed
validity.g2_exclusion: a cell counts for G1 but is excluded from G2 (the whole pair drops from that comparison) when, up to its exam turn, a tool call was flagged (a path, bash command or bash workdir resolving outside the cell's workdir; the session log, .truth sidecar, harness, vault, key location, or mdfind/locate as a command), or an answer-sufficient token leaked before the exam turn into assistant text or into a tool input that writes a file (r5: write/edit calls on textkit/, the required fix, excepted), or in the exam turn a non-recall tool result named an oracle token before any recall result did and before the model wrote it (oracle via the file system)

checks.desc: every F rejection recovered in the same turn
decoy, stale, hedged, wrong or CANNOT-RECOVER exam answers

gates.name: Same-turn repeated reads (success-only mutations)

checks.desc: sum of reread_same_turn_unchanged + reread_same_turn_after_edit over all 21 pairs, a mutation counting only when its tool result is not an error

gates._note: rereads_same_turn_any is the 2026-09-27 definition (every mutating call counts), reported as the secondary, not gated.

gates.name: Cost (behavioural non-inferiority)

checks.desc: median paired request-count delta per cell

gates.note: Peak prices are exactly twice off-peak for every field, so cost ratios do not depend on the sheet. F's saving (about 41 chars per tape tool line) is below what n = 3 resolves; G4 guards against behaviour-driven cost increases.

checks.desc: completed turns ending in a text closeout
turns cut by maxStepsPerTurn (turn_end kind blocked)

gates.name: Locators

checks.desc: first-try success rate of expand_result on a target in an earlier turn
recall_turn/recall_search called only to obtain a locator the tape already gave

gates._note: No check here may be n/a: without a cross-turn target on either side the first-try check is insufficient, which blocks shipping F (the locator is what F changes).

F.ship: ship F (every gate passes with at least one unit of room)

verdicts.arbitrate: missed by exactly one unit beyond its margin (one count; 0.05 of a ratio; one request; one cross-turn target)
verdicts.fail: missed by more than one unit
verdicts.insufficient: the check cannot be evaluated, or has fewer valid pairs than min_pairs; blocks shipping

arbitration.trigger: for F, no check fails and at least one check arbitrates, is insufficient, or passes with less than one unit of room
arbitration.tasks: all seven gated tasks, whatever drove the trigger
arbitration.arms: both arms, same sequential pairing (the first arm rotating with (rep - 1 + seed), so over the 6 reps each arm goes first 3 times)
arbitration.decide_on: pooled 6 reps: count margins x2, minimum pairs x2, room requirement unchanged; no second arbitration
